name: ModelVariant153Us_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant153us_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a textured 5x5 sheet grows at the followed slot part, then a single five-entry trail of sheets travels to the second anchor, a point offset by the configured radius from the opposite slot's position at height -350; one sheet is retained at the followed-part anchor and one at the second anchor, both spin there, and a white flash closes the effect); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, seeds the sheets and packs one texture image, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 until the trail arrives, 4 while they spin and hold, 2 once the flash has ended, 1 once when the flash starts and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-170 and 300 images build it from the same source and bind its data names 0x24 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
